data.name: Cele
data.gender_notes: Cele is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word κελευτης (keluetēs), meaning 'receiver of praise' or 'praiseworthy'. In Christian tradition, Cele represents the joyful and faithful servant of God. The name Cele carries the meaning “Rejoicing, Praise” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cele usually hope their child will grow to embody rejoicing, praise and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cele total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
